text:
danielle: alert: unexpected SetIamPolicy on KMS key projects/prod/locations/global/keyRings/bridge/cryptoKeys/secret-bridge at 2026-07-14T02:10Z. principal vendor-sync@thirdparty added roles/cloudkms.cryptoKeyEncrypterDecrypter.
marc: ugh. that key is used by Vault transit for partner-bridge and a handful of backup snapshots. any audit snippet?
priya: pasted admin audit snippet:
```
{"protoPayload":{"methodName":"google.iam.v1.IAM.SetIamPolicy","principalEmail":"vendor-sync@thirdparty","resourceName":"projects/prod/locations/global/keyRings/bridge/cryptoKeys/secret-bridge","timestamp":"2026-07-14T02:10:07Z"}}
```
rotor-bot: [automated] anomaly score high for cross-project grant. Recommended containment: snapshot key IAM, export 30d audit, create ephemeral ops-SA for rewrap, revoke suspect binding, rewrap ciphertexts, rotate downstream secrets. Incident INC-2026-330 created and paged oncall.
sec-oncall: oncall here. agree staged approach. full revoke may break backups; propose canary revoke and rewrap. who can enumerate CMEK deps?
vault-admin: running quick asset search now:
```
gcloud asset search-all-resources --scope=projects/prod --query="cryptoKeys/name:secret-bridge" --format=json
```
vault-admin: results: vault-transit-bridge, backups-bridge-2025, snapshot-archive, bridge-worker-fn.
marc: vendor says they ran a sync but their logs show no SetIamPolicy. suspicious automation gap. we'll treat as potential misconfig.
priya: containment plan: 1) create ephemeral ops-SA with minimal KMS rewrap rights 2) grant to SRE rewrap team 3) revoke vendor binding 4) run canary rewrap on snapshot-archive 5) rotate Vault transit keys and affected secrets.
sec-oncall: created ephemeral ops-SA at 4765432260 and granted limited permissions. will revoke vendor binding at T+5m after ops-SA is ready.
rotor-bot: [automated] snapshot of key metadata saved and KMS audit export started: https://logs.internal/exports/secret-bridge-476543.json :lock:
marc: revoke executed at 4765432385. monitoring for failures.
vault-admin: canary rewrap command:
```
./scripts/rewrap_kms --src secret-bridge --dst secret-bridge-rot-20260714 --resources ./canary-snapshot.json --parallel 4
```
vault-admin: canary passed; bridge-worker-fn and Vault transit smoke tests OK. one backup job retried and recovered.
priya: starting token rotation playbook for apps that read KMS-wrapped secrets. will roll by canary groups overnight.
marc: post-actions: add alert rule for cross-project KMS grants without IAM conditions, require terraform-locked IAM changes in vendor onboarding, and increase KMS audit retention to 90d. vendor-sec, can you follow up with vendor for root cause and mitigation?
vendor-sec: will open follow-up and require patch to their automation + attestation. also adding CI check for unconditional KMS grants.
sec-oncall: ephemeral ops-SA revoked at 4765432950. keeping incident open until all rotations finish and vendor actions are verified. thanks team :thumbsup:
